name: H2O
summary: Keep the tokens that have received the most attention so far, plus a recent window. The first policy here that reads attention, and so the first that finds important old tokens, not merely early ones.

source.title: H2O: Heavy-Hitter Oracle for Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models

params.name: budget
params.description: Maximum token positions kept in the cache.

params.name: recentWindow
params.description: The most recent positions, never evicted whatever their score.
